sessions.topic: ScopeBind proposal and initial evaluation of accessibility-filtered recombination
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial evaluation ends before a separate ablation and audit.

sessions.topic: Independent evaluation exposes ScopeBind accessibility errors and subthreshold withheld accuracy
sessions.boundary_reason: The finding motivates a shift to constrained decoding.

sessions.topic: Scope-state binder masking improves accessibility but misses the withheld-accuracy target
sessions.boundary_reason: The remaining accuracy gap prompts investigation of quantifier ordering.

sessions.topic: Quantifier-order reranking brings scope-state ScopeBind above both accuracy targets
sessions.boundary_reason: The approach is adopted before a separate residual-error audit.

sessions.topic: Residual-100 audit of the adopted ScopeBind parser
sessions.boundary_reason: The audit artifact is complete; discussion shifts to a CCG alternative.

sessions.topic: Typed CCG chart coverage and parser accuracy
sessions.boundary_reason: The CCG evaluation ends before a different parsing proposal.

sessions.topic: Typed-fragment unification evaluation and rejection as the primary parser
sessions.boundary_reason: The decision closes this alternative before continuation parsing begins.

sessions.topic: Initial representation and accuracy tests for typed continuation parsing
sessions.boundary_reason: Initial results are followed by a separate depth and contrast recheck.

sessions.topic: Independent recheck finds collapsed scope contrasts in continuations
sessions.boundary_reason: The failures prompt a revised representation.

sessions.topic: Quantifier-order tags resolve continuation scope collisions and are adopted
sessions.boundary_reason: The revision is adopted before a separate tag ablation.
The report is complete before the cross-parser audit.
